Dear Ms Zellner,

We propose EUR 29.89/unit for a binding 23,400/year, 24 months and 56 days.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is our estimate, not your actual cost.

Would you sponsor this package for manager approval if needed? We would gladly support your business case with the firm commitment.

Kind regards, Hollerau Purchasing

reply.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your request for an increased volume of 23,400 units over a 24-month contract term. 

In consideration of these parameters and the 56-day lead time, we can offer a revised price of €31.80 per unit. For clarity, our offer comprises a price of €31.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.text:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quote. We raise our proposal to EUR 30.90 and add a third committed year: 23,400/year, 36 months and 56 days.

Supplier-wide on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask for commercial recognition of this service record. We would conclude on this complete package.

If approval is needed, we would be glad to support your business case.

Kind regards, Hollerau Purchasing

reply.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal for a 36-month contract and an annual volume of 23,400 units. The delivery record you referenced has been reviewed but does not justify your proposed price. 

We can accommodate these extended terms at a revised unit price of €31.60. Our Angebot consists of a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
